item.title: S4 & T1: Track in 10 - Using the Novation Peak
item.description: video upload by torso electronics "An empty project and 10 minutes on the clock. In an uninterrupted one take we explore ideas, sculpt sounds, and let the S4 and T1 guide the moment. 'Track in 10' is about staying in the flow and creating without overthinking. In this “Track in 10” we are using the T1 to sequence the Novation Peak, and utilizing the looping and processing capabilities on the S4
